notes: POC deployment from nvflare poc prepare and start; job from FedAvgRecipe, submitted through the FLARE API

total_seconds runs from before submit to the terminal job status, polled every 0.2s, so it includes job scheduling, deployment and teardown; fedavg_seconds is the Start to Finished span in the server job log
POC start-up, result download and the model check are not timed
the server job process builds the initial model through the persistor, inside total_seconds and fedavg_seconds; model_load_seconds is that step
site job processes reach the server parent over mTLS; each job process to its own parent is local plain TCP
the custom persistor stands in for NPModelPersistor, which holds a single array
